Recall number:

26-090

Recall Date:

November 13, 2025
Belkin Recalls Portable Power Banks and Wireless Charging Stands
This recall involves charging stands with model number MMA008
Serial numbers (14 digits) starting with “57X” are included in this recall and are also printed on the bottom of the charging stand.
Belkin Recalls Portable Power Banks and Wireless Charging Stands
power banks with model numbers BPB002
Serial numbers (14 digits) starting with “35S” are included in this recall and are also printed on the back of the power bank.
Belkin Recalls Portable Power Banks and Wireless Charging Stands
Model number “PB0003” is printed on the back of the power bank. All serial numbers are included in this recall.
